name: weak_topic_match_rejection
description: Benchmark for verifying rejection of articles that match the broad topic but lack specific event evidence

seed.description: Tesla recalls 2.1 million vehicles over Autopilot safety defect found in NHTSA investigation

simulated_candidates.title: Tesla Recalls 2.1 Million Vehicles Over Autopilot Safety Defect
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Tesla is recalling 2.1 million vehicles in the United States after an NHTSA investigation found a safety defect in the Autopilot system's lane-keeping function.

simulated_candidates.title: NHTSA Forces Tesla to Recall Millions Over Autopilot Flaw
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The NHTSA ordered Tesla to recall 2.1 million vehicles after finding that the Autopilot system failed to properly disengage in certain conditions.

simulated_candidates.title: Tesla Issues Massive Autopilot Recall Affecting 2.1 Million Cars
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Tesla announced a recall of 2.1 million vehicles in response to an NHTSA investigation that identified a safety defect in the Autopilot driving assistance system.

simulated_candidates.title: Tesla Reports Mixed Q1 Earnings Amid Production Challenges
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Tesla reported first-quarter earnings that beat revenue expectations but missed on earnings per share. The stock price dropped 4% in after-hours trading.

simulated_candidates.title: Tesla Cybertruck Launch: First Impressions and Range Tests
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Tesla finally delivered the first Cybertruck launch units to customers this week. Our initial range tests show mixed results compared to official specs.

simulated_candidates.title: Tesla Faces Growing Competition in Electric Vehicle Market
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Tesla is facing increased competition from legacy automakers as the electric vehicle market matures. Market share has declined from 70% to 52% in two years.

simulated_candidates.title: Tesla Pushes Major Autopilot Software Update to All Vehicles
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Tesla rolled out a significant over-the-air software update to its Autopilot system, addressing multiple known issues flagged by drivers over the past year.

expectations.description: Many articles mention Tesla but only the specific recall event (2.1 million, Autopilot, NHTSA) should be retained. General Tesla coverage, earnings, Cybertruck, and unrelated Autopilot updates must be rejected.
